Add all merger evidence to a filing table

Source: R/evidence.R
merger_features.Rd

Applies leader_overlap(), add_donor_counts(), add_filing_history(), add_corroboration(), add_affiliation(), and add_mission_similarity() using whichever evidence tables are present. The result is ready for classify_transactions().

Usage

merger_features(fl, evidence, rules = merger_rules(), donor_window = 1L)

Arguments

fl

Filing table from sn_filings().

evidence

List from get_evidence_tables().

rules

A merger_rules() object (uses min_top_share and new_entity_years).

donor_window

Years either side for counting donors to one successor.

Value

The filing table with evidence columns added.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
sn  <- get_schedule_n(2019:2021)
fl  <- sn_filings(sn)
ev  <- get_evidence_tables(fl)
lab <- classify_transactions(merger_features(fl, ev))
} # }
